firstRun.antiCheatNote: Don't use SavePoint with online games protected by anti-cheat. Changed game files can get your account flagged, and those games can't be modded or rolled back anyway.
firstRun.artworkNote: SavePoint downloads cover art for Steam games from Steam. You can turn this off in Settings.
firstRun.body: Point SavePoint at a game you've already got installed and modded. It takes snapshots of that exact version, its mods and its saves, so you can go back to them later, even after the game updates.
firstRun.storageNote: SavePoint keeps your snapshots in {path}. You can change that in Settings.
firstRun.title: Keep the setup that works
shell.exit.clearMessage: SavePoint is still removing its data. If you quit now, some of it will be left, and you can remove the rest later.
shell.exit.freeUpMessage: SavePoint is freeing up space and can't stop now, because it has started deleting the snapshots you chose to delete. It can quit as soon as it is done.
shell.exit.moveMessage: SavePoint is still moving your snapshots. If you quit now, the move stops and your snapshots stay where they are.
shell.exit.switchMessage: SavePoint is switching your game's folder to another snapshot. If you quit now, the folder is left with a mix of two snapshots until the switch is finished or the changes are discarded.
shell.exit.title: SavePoint is still working
shell.jobStatus.clearFailure: Something went wrong clearing SavePoint's data.
shell.jobStatus.clearPartial: Some of SavePoint's data couldn't be removed.
shell.jobStatus.compactAllFailure: Something went wrong freeing up space.
shell.jobStatus.compactAllPartial: Freed up space for some of your games.
shell.jobStatus.compactAllSuccess: Freed up space for all your games.
shell.jobStatus.compactFailure: Something went wrong freeing up space for {gameName}.
shell.jobStatus.compactPartial: Freed up only part of the space for {gameName}.
shell.jobStatus.failure: Something went wrong taking a snapshot of {gameName}.
shell.jobStatus.partial: Only part of {gameName} is in the new snapshot.
shell.jobStatus.relocateFailure: Something went wrong moving your snapshots.
shell.jobStatus.relocatePartial: Snapshots moved, but some old files are still in the old folder.
shell.jobStatus.switchSuccess: {gameName}'s files are switched. The game was not started.
shell.layout.label: Layout
shell.nav.label: Main
startup.finishingCleanup: SavePoint is finishing a cleanup it started earlier. This can take a few minutes, and your games are not touched meanwhile.
startup.corrupt.body: SavePoint couldn't read the file that holds {kind, select, games {your list of games} profiles {your list of profiles} settings {your settings} other {some of its data}}, so it left the file exactly as it is. "Restore the backup" brings back the last good copy. "Start with nothing in it" begins again with {kind, select, games {no games listed} profiles {no profiles listed} settings {the default settings} other {an empty file}} and keeps the unreadable file next to it.
startup.corrupt.confirm.message: SavePoint will move the unreadable file aside, never delete it, and start with {kind, select, games {no games listed} profiles {no profiles listed} settings {the default settings} other {an empty file}}.
startup.corrupt.confirm.title: Start with nothing in it?
startup.corrupt.intro: SavePoint left each of these files exactly as it found it. Choose what to do with each one. The unreadable file is moved aside, never deleted.
startup.corrupt.movedTo: The unreadable file was moved to {path}.
startup.corrupt.noBackup: There is no backup copy of this file.
startup.corrupt.title: {kind, select, games {Your game list couldn't be read} profiles {Your profile list couldn't be read} settings {Your settings couldn't be read} other {SavePoint couldn't read one of its files}}
startup.logFolderFailed: SavePoint couldn't open the log folder. You can find it at the path above.
startup.restartNeeded.body: {reason} Close SavePoint and open it again to try once more.
startup.restartNeeded.bodyWithLog: {reason} Close SavePoint and open it again to try once more. If it keeps happening, send the newest file from the log folder when you report it.
startup.restartNeeded.title: SavePoint couldn't start
startup.storage.choices: If the folder moved, or the drive has a new letter, choose where it is now. If it's gone for good, you can start over with an empty folder: your games and profiles stay listed, but none of their snapshots come with them, and each profile starts again from its next snapshot.
startup.storage.confirm.message: SavePoint will stop using {path} and start with an empty folder of its own. Your games stay listed, but their snapshots stay behind in {path}, and SavePoint won't use them again. Each profile starts again from its next snapshot.
startup.storage.confirm.title: Start with an empty folder?
startup.storage.pickTitle: Choose the folder that holds your snapshots
templatePicker.body: Pick a ready-made setup to fill in the details, or open a game settings file someone shared.
templatePicker.title: Start from a template
